description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'PurgeStrategy' within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The class provides a strategy framework for purging or deleting data entities related to employee records, including methods for retrieving purge services, matching entity data, and managing parameters used in the purge process.
published: OrangeHRM ile name and namespace declarations

classes.name: PurgeStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides a common interface and utility methods for various data purging strategies in the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It manages entity-specific information, parameters, and leverages a purge service to perform data deletion operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the purge strategy with entity class name and metadata from InfoArray, setting up field mappings and parameters.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: An abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for executing the specific data purging logic for an employee.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PurgeService instance used to perform data purge operations.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Builds and returns an array of matching criteria based on employee number and entity field mappings.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Fetches entity records matching specific criteria by invoking the purge DAO's extraction method.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters array configured for this purge strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity class that this purge strategy operates on.

methods.name: getEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Returns the field mapping used for matching entities.
